name: Clap-and-stomp church beat
desc: Congregation rhythm section: floor-tom-plus-kick stomp on 1 and 3, big layered claps on 2 and 4 with slapback, tambourine 8ths driving. Doubles into clap 8ths at peak like the whole church catching the spirit. No hats, no cymbals - just bodies.

gain.doc: stomp level, claps scale from it

crowd.doc: clap stack level as fraction of stomp

code.full: stack(s("[bd,lt] ~ [bd,lt] ~").gain(${gain}).shape(.3).lpf(1400), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*${crowd}).room(.35).roomsize(4).delay(.25).delaytime(.08).delayfeedback(.2), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*${crowd}*.6).late(.015).pan(.6), s("tb*8").gain("[.5 .26]*4").hpf(1400).pan(cosine.range(.5,.64).slow(10))).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[bd,lt] ~ [bd,lt] [~ bd]").gain(${gain}).shape(.35).lpf(1400), s("~ [cp cp] ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR909").gain(${gain}*${crowd}).room(.35).roomsize(4).delay(.3).delaytime(.08).delayfeedback(.25), s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(${gain}*${crowd}*.7).late(.015).pan(.62), s("tb*8").gain("[.55 .3]*4").hpf(1300).pan(cosine.range(.46,.68).slow(8)).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("lt*16").degradeBy(.88).gain(.2).pan(.4)).orbit(1).play()
